full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 04 June 2010 MAYOR ISARME A. BOSQUE Polillo, Quezon Dear Mayor Bosque: 80 s. 2010 This pertains to Kapasyahan Blg. 005-2009 of the indigenous people of the Province of Quezon, requesting sectoral representation of Indigenous People in the Sangguniang Bayan that has jurisdiction over their respective domains and invoking pertinent provisions of RA 7160. The aforesaid Kapasyahan was forwarded to this level via an indorsement from DILG Region IV-A Director Josefina Castilla-Go. In this regard, please be informed that we have already answered a similar concern in DILG Opinion No. 69, s. 2007, where we opined that RA 8371 and its Implementing Rules issued by the National Commission on Indigenous People (NCIP) is already sufficient as an enabling law to install the indigenous people's representatives in the different Sanggunians of Local Government Units. Attached herewith is the photocopy of DILG Opinion No. 69, s. 2007, for your ready reference. Thank you. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: Director Encl.: a/s LS:20/e en/La
